name: Mahlkönig WebSocket grinders
author: Decaid contributors
description: Read-only Mahlkönig grinder telemetry over the local JSON WebSocket API. Only the E64 WS is tested; the E64 TS and NG2 GbS models are untested.

InstancesJson.label: Grinder instances
InstancesJson.description: JSON array of id, name, host, port, optional scheme (wss by default, ws allowed), optional pollMs, optional certSha256 (pinned SHA-256 of the grinder certificate) and optional restPort (login HTTPS port, default 443). Hosts must be loopback, private, link-local or .local.

TokensJson.label: Grinder session tokens
TokensJson.description: JSON object mapping instance ids to {"host": <instance host>, "token": <token>}. An entry is only used while the instance host matches.

MintTokens.label: Mint tokens on connect
MintTokens.description: When true, empty TokensJson entries are filled by logging in on each connect. Requires PasswordsJson or AllowNoPasswordWorkaround.

DebugLog.label: Verbose connection diagnostics
DebugLog.description: Keep the underlying error message and code of every connect stage in the staged diagnostics log (read=stages) and the diagnostics bundle (read=diagnostics), instead of the stage, class and timing only. Secrets stay redacted at both levels. Default false.

PasswordsJson.label: Grinder Owner passwords
PasswordsJson.description: JSON object mapping instance ids to {"host": <instance host>, "password": <Owner password>}. Stored as a secure setting and never logged; re-enter it after changing the instance host.

UseLocalApi.label: Use the Local API
UseLocalApi.description: Read the grind and service logs through the Local Owner API v1 before the vendor ZIP download. Needs a deployed Local API module, a development image and an entry in ApiTokensJson. Default false.

ApiTokensJson.label: Grinder Local API tokens
ApiTokensJson.description: JSON object mapping instance ids to {"host": <instance host>, "token": <Local Owner API v1 token>}. Only used while the instance host matches and Use the Local API is on. This token is separate from the WSS token and is stored as a secure setting, never in the ordinary settings.

AllowNoPasswordWorkaround.label: Allow no-password workaround
AllowNoPasswordWorkaround.description: Use the documented FW-01 SELECT-only login construction when no Owner password is set. This is an authentication bypass; enable only on an owner-controlled device. Default false.

AllowControl.label: Allow grinder control
AllowControl.description: Probe once per load whether the grinder runs an owner-enabled development image; only then register start/stop and grind-setting control. Locked grinders stay read-only. Requires MintTokens. See docs/DEBUG_MODE.md. Default false.

SyncBacklight.label: Sync grinder backlight
SyncBacklight.description: With control available, turn the grinder backlight off while the espresso machine sleeps and back on when it wakes. Default false.

AdjustmentOwner.label: Grind adjustment owner
AdjustmentOwner.description: off: no brew events and no grind-setting writes. grinder: report finished Decaid shots to the grinder's own grind-by-sync as brew events. decaid: allow grind-setting writes from Decaid, never send brew events. Default off.

PopulateGrinderRecord.label: Add the grinder to Decaid's inventory
PopulateGrinderRecord.description: On connect, keep one Decaid grinder record per instance (created once, or an existing E64 record adopted). Only plugin-owned extras are updated afterwards; an archived record is left alone. Default true.

LinkWorkflowGrinder.label: Link the workflow to this grinder
LinkWorkflowGrinder.description: When the current workflow names no grinder, set its grinder to this record. An existing grinder choice is never replaced. Default true.

SyncWorkflowGrinder.label: Keep the workflow's grinder details current
SyncWorkflowGrinder.description: While this grinder is the workflow's grinder, keep its model and burrs from the grinder record, its setting equal to the grinder's display (not during a shot, and not over a value you set in the last 10 minutes unless the dial moved), and grind metadata under context.extras. Default true.

RecordGrindDose.label: Record each grind as the shot's dose
RecordGrindDose.description: While this grinder is the workflow's grinder: after a grind-by-weight grind, set the workflow's dose to the grinder's target; after a shot that started within 5 minutes of a grind, store the ground weight as the shot's actual dose and the grind's details (target, result, deviation, overshoot, setting, motor time, age, and from the grinder log the trigger, whether the portafilter was recognized, and the recipe with whether its dose and coarseness were applied) under annotations.extras. Needs Keep the workflow's grinder details current for the target dose. Default false.
